mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_tool_output_code_interpreter ( tool_invocation_id, run_id, request_id, session_id, tool_call_id, status, error_msg, code_output, content, code, explain, file_refs_json, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{row.toolInvocationId}, #{row.runId}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.sessionId}, #{row.toolCallId}, #{row.status}, #{row.errorMsg}, #{row.codeOutput}, #{row.content}, #{row.code}, #{row.explain}, #{row.fileRefsJson}, NOW(), NOW() FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_tool_output_code_interpreter WHERE (#{row.toolInvocationId} IS NOT NULL AND tool_invocation_id = #{row.toolInvocationId}) OR (request_id = #{row.requestId} AND tool_call_id = #{row.toolCallId}) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tool_invocation_id, run_id, request_id, session_id, tool_call_id, status, error_msg, code_output, content, code, explain, file_refs_json, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_agent_tool_output_code_interpreter WHERE tool_invocation_id = #{toolInvocationId} LIMIT 1
